sections.triggerRule: Trigger ONLY if Pain Level > 0. Hide if Pain = 0. If no explicit pain level, show only if description clearly suggests pain
sections.contentGuidelines: If pain is present, prioritize active pain management over passive modalities where possible.

sections.triggerRule: Standard of care for acute MSK.
sections.contentGuidelines: Address swelling, spasm, mobility restrictions, and scar mobilization.

sections.triggerRule: Essential for restoring ROM and initial activation.

sections.triggerRule: Primary functional section. Must be separate from ADLs.
sections.contentGuidelines: Focus on: Functional reaching, functional transfers, functional standing tasks, ambulation/gait, navigation.

sections.triggerRule: Trigger if injury involves instability (ankle/knee/shoulder) or proprioceptive deficits.
sections.contentGuidelines: Focus on proprioception and joint position sense.

sections.triggerRule: Trigger if patient has specific Return-to-Sport or Return-to-Work goals.
sections.contentGuidelines: Job simulation tasks, sport-specific drills.

sections.triggerRule: Trigger if injury impacts self-care (e.g., bilateral fractures, weight-bearing precautions).
sections.contentGuidelines: Modifications for grooming, dressing, bathing with injury. INCLUDES: Environmental & Contextual Modifications.

sections.triggerRule: Trigger only if injury site is Hand, Wrist, or Elbow.
sections.contentGuidelines: Manipulation, dexterity, tool use.

sections.triggerRule: Trigger ONLY if Pain Level > 0. Hide if Pain = 0. If no explicit pain level, show only if description clearly suggests pain
sections.contentGuidelines: Post-op pain management (active and passive).

sections.triggerRule: Required for scar mobilization, fluid management, and passive ROM.

Protocol-based strengthening and ROM.

sections.triggerRule: Trigger for Lower Extremity surgeries or spine stability.
sections.contentGuidelines: Specify Level: Static, Dynamic, Dual Task, Visual Reduction, Reaching, Perturbations.

sections.triggerRule: Trigger if precautions exist (e.g., Hip Precautions, Sternotomy) requiring adaptive strategies.

sections.triggerRule: Trigger only for Hand/Upper Extremity surgeries.
sections.contentGuidelines: Tendon gliding, grasp, object manipulation.

sections.triggerRule: Trigger ONLY if Pain Level > 0. Hide if Pain = 0. If no explicit pain level, show only if description clearly suggests pain

sections.contentGuidelines: Contracture prevention, spasticity reduction.

sections.triggerRule: Crucial for maintaining function and preventing atrophy.
sections.contentGuidelines: General conditioning, functional strengthening.

Sit-to-stand, functional walking, community mobility, navigation.

sections.triggerRule: Focus on energy conservation and joint protection.
sections.contentGuidelines: Energy conservation (COPD/CHF), Joint protection (RA), Adaptive equipment.

sections.triggerRule: Trigger if condition has cognitive components (MS, Parkinson's, Dementia).
sections.contentGuidelines: OT Focus: Attention, working memory, sequencing, problem solving, initiation, safety awareness.

sections.triggerRule: Trigger for arthritis or neurological hand deficits.
sections.contentGuidelines: Buttoning, container opening, handling medication.
Home safety assessment, grab bars, ramp recommendations, lighting.

sections.triggerRule: Trigger for progressive conditions affecting speech/expression.

sections.triggerRule: Core component for gross motor delays.
